title: Copyright 2021 The On Combining Bags to Better Learn from Label Proportions Authors. All R
summary: Productization of the AISTATS'22 bag-combination method for learning from label proportions, which improves LLP training by combining bags rather than treating them independently, evaluated against almostnolabel and LMMCM baselines on pseudo-synthetic datasets. Target: better bag-level modeling accuracy for the data-platforms LLP stack.
